doc.name: Blue Crane — Canadian Contractor Forms & Tax Tools
doc.instructions: Blue Crane's Canadian contractor form and tax tools. Start with search_forms or which_form_do_i_need for paperwork, estimate_contractor_tax for tax questions. All forms are free to fill and print; always pass the fill_and_print_free URL to the user. Note: Blue Crane provides preparation worksheets and on-site records. It does not file anything with any ministry or tribunal.

tools.name: search_forms
tools.title: Search Ontario contractor forms
tools.description: Search Blue Crane's compendium of 126 Canadian contractor forms — Ontario, Alberta and BC statutory worksheets plus Canada-wide site paperwork (safety, statutory worksheets, inspections, invoices, sign-offs, site logs) by keyword, form number, or alias (e.g. 'FLHA', 'form 1.2', 'hot work', 'toolbox talk'). Returns matching forms with citations and free fill-and-print URLs.

query.description: Keywords, a form number, or an alias

tools.name: get_form
tools.title: Get form details
tools.description: Get full details for one form by its id (from search_forms): description, regulatory citation, the exact fields it collects, and free print / Pass options.

tools.name: which_form_do_i_need
tools.title: Which form do I need?
tools.description: Describe a jobsite or paperwork situation in plain language (e.g. 'starting an $80k renovation in Ontario', 'GC is not paying my invoice', 'crew doing welding tomorrow') and get the forms that fit, with citations and free print links. Guidance only — not legal advice.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.title: List form categories
tools.description: List the form categories (WSIB & incidents, site safety, vehicles & equipment, finance, subcontractors, etc.) with what each covers and how many forms it holds.

tools.name: estimate_contractor_tax
tools.title: Estimate contractor tax (Canada)
tools.description: Estimate 2026 income tax, CPP, and take-home for a self-employed Canadian contractor or tradesperson (sole proprietor) by province. Uses sourced CRA and provincial rates from tradestaxcalculator.ca. Provinces: ontario, alberta, bc, saskatchewan, manitoba, new-brunswick, nova-scotia, pei, newfoundland, yukon, nwt, nunavut (no Quebec). Planning estimate, not tax advice.

revenue.description: Gross self-employment revenue for the year, CAD (before HST)

tools.name: required_hourly_rate
tools.title: Required hourly rate for a target take-home
tools.description: Work backwards from the annual take-home a contractor wants to the hourly rate they must bill, accounting for 2026 income tax and CPP in their province plus billable time. Planning estimate.

tools.name: hst_quick_method
tools.title: HST Quick Method comparison (Ontario)
tools.description: Compare the CRA Quick Method of accounting for HST against the regular method for an Ontario contractor: what they would remit and keep under each, with the break-even. Planning estimate.

operating_itcs.description: GST/HST paid on operating expenses that the regular method would reclaim as ITCs, CAD (default 0)

type.description: Business type for the quick-method rate (default services)

tools.name: get_form_maker_pass
tools.title: Form Maker Pass pricing
tools.description: Pricing and checkout links for the Blue Crane Form Maker Pass: one-time purchase that strips all Blue Crane text from printed PDFs (clean, client-ready paper) and auto-fills saved company details across all 126 forms.
